public_rationale: The reliability concern has substantial support. Salesforce found marked deterioration when agents needed clarification, and METR documented difficulties with sustained work. Neither establishes that agents are fundamentally unworkable. Salesforce also found stronger workflow performance, and later architectural experiments report substantial improvements. Those counterexamples weaken the causal generalization but do not settle dependable real-world operation across the claim's unspecified scope.
limitations: Multi-turn interaction is not synonymous with multistep execution.
Benchmark results do not directly establish deployment reliability or economic usefulness.
Later evidence bears on the claimed inherent limitation, not on what was available in June 2025.
